rec.name: Sub-Collection Bubble Navigation (Full-Width Row)
rec.status: Built — live in theme editor (alignment and gap settings visible)

what.text: A Sectionfy 'Sub-collections' section that shows a row of clickable collection shortcuts, each a circular image with a label underneath. In the screenshots it sits directly under the press-logo bar on the homepage and links to Starter Set, Refill Pack - 60 Stk, Fastenzeit 2025 and Bio Gemüsebrühe. The ticket title ('Sub-Collection auf gesamte Breite') says the row should use the full content width. In the screenshots this is handled through the 'Gap between items' and 'Alignment' (Left/Center) settings.

why.text: Image bubbles above the fold give visitors a fast, visual way to jump to the product group they want, which shortens the path to a product and reduces decision effort. Spreading the row evenly across the full width makes every option equally visible and looks deliberate rather than crammed into the left corner. Showing seasonal or bundle collections such as 'Fastenzeit 2025' and 'Starter Set' on the homepage also pushes high-intent offers, which can lift AOV.

how.text: Add the Sectionfy 'Sub-collections' section to the template, below the hero or logo bar, then click 'Add Collection' for each bubble. Set Style to 'Show bubbles' and Image style to Circle. Set image size to about 80px on desktop and 65px on mobile. Increase 'Gap between items' (the slider goes up to 100px) and choose Alignment Left or Center so the row spans the full width. Keep the gap small on mobile (about 10px). Use Custom CSS for fine adjustments if needed.

items: Image size (desktop, ~80px) and Image size for mobile (~65px)
Font size (14–19px) and Font size for mobile (14px)
Text Color (Transparent by default in the screenshot, so it needs a visible colour to show)
Gap between items (up to 100px on desktop) and Gap between items mobile (~10px)

dependencies.text: Needs the Sectionfy app/section library in the theme. Each bubble needs an existing Shopify collection with a collection image. Only the homepage is shown in the screenshots; use on collection pages is an inference. No metafields are visible.

items: Share of sessions that reach a collection or PDP from the homepage
Conversion rate and AOV for sessions that click a bubble

images.caption: Live homepage: a row of circular sub-collection bubbles (Starter Set, Refill Pack - 60 Stk, Fastenzeit 2025, Bio Gemüsebrühe) under the press-logo bar. The red box highlights the row that should span the full width.
Settings panel: font size, mobile font size, text color, gap between items (100px desktop / 10px mobile) and Static/Absolute positioning.
Theme editor with the Sub-collections section selected. Style, image size, gap and the Left/Center alignment option (circled in red) are visible.
